cs.t: I've sworn by Plantronics headphones for years for work but started getting ear infections and my open air/bone conducting headphones are a huge improvement... I've got a pair of Aftershockz but these look great as well. Audio quality suffers a little when it comes to music, but being able to hear conversations around me at the office is worth it.
cs.th: Ask HN: Life-changing purchases since 2020? (Under $100 and under $1000)
